passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully consider the risk factors set forth below as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K in connection with evaluating the Company. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. Certain statements in “Risk Factors” are forward-looking statements. See “Item 7 — Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations — Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements .” Summary of Risk Factors The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results. Risks Related to Our Business • Our business is particularly sensitive to reductions in discretionary consumer and corporate spending as a result of downturns in the economy. • Natural or man-made disasters, an outbreak of highly infectious or contagious disease, political instability, civil unrest, terrorist activity or war could materially adversely affect the number of visitors to our facilities and disrupt our operations. • Our business is sensitive to the willingness of our customers to travel. • We are subject to extensive regulations that govern our operations in any jurisdiction where we operate. • Certain local gaming laws apply to our gaming activities and associations in jurisdictions where we operate or plan to operate. • We depend primarily on our properties in two markets for all of our cash flow, and because we are a parent company, our primary source of cash is and will be distributions from our subsidiaries. • Our debt instruments, current debt service obligations and substantial indebtedness may restrict our current and future operations. • We are subject to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates. • We extend credit to a portion of our patrons, and we may not be able to collect gaming receivables from our credit patrons. • Win rates for our gaming operations depend on a variety of factors, some beyond our control, and the winnings of our gaming patrons could exceed our casino winnings. 18 Table of Conte n ts • We face the risk of fraud and cheating. • Our operations face significant competition, which may increase in the future. • Our attempts to expand our business into new markets and new ventures, including through acquisitions or strategic transactions, may not be successful. • Our loan receivable is subject to certain risks, which could materially adversely affect our financial position, results of operations and cash flows. • There are significant risks associated with our current and planned credit_strengths.text: Operating margin sits well above the consumer discretionary sector median, reflecting the pricing power of the integrated resort portfolio and disciplined cost control across Macao and Singapore. Revenue and operating income both grew year over year, and the margin expanded slightly, supporting the view that earnings quality is improving rather than merely volume-driven.

Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure and dividends, and free cash flow alone covers the dividend more than twice over. This internal liquidity generation funds the committed construction programme without incremental borrowing, which is a meaningful strength given the group's heavy reinvestment needs.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage both sit materially above the sector median, and net leverage is only marginally below the next risk-band boundary, leaving limited headroom. A modest EBITDA decline or incremental debt would push the profile into a weaker tier, so the current Significant indicative profile is sensitive to earnings volatility.

The risk factors flag dependence on two markets for essentially all cash flow, with the parent reliant on subsidiary distributions, alongside concession and licence termination exposure in Macao and Singapore. Consumer discretionary sensitivity and travel disruption compound this concentration, making cash flow less resilient than the diversified peer set.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains comfortably above unity, but it is roughly half the sector median, reflecting the size of the debt stack relative to operating income. Coverage is adequate rather than strong, and the gap to peers is structural given the capital-intensive resort model.

The maturity ladder is well spread, with the largest single-year concentration falling in the third year and a substantial tail beyond year five. Near-term maturities are modest relative to cash balances and annual free cash flow, so refinancing risk is manageable, though the ladder assumes continued market access at reasonable spreads.

overall_credit_view.text: Shareholder distributions absorb more than operating cash flow and materially exceed free cash flow, so buybacks are effectively funded from balance sheet capacity rather than internally generated cash. This is the key judgement in the credit view: returns to shareholders compete directly with deleveraging and the construction programme.

Our forward view is that the issuer retains an investment-grade-like operating profile but carries leverage above the sector median with thin headroom to the next band. Deleveraging depends on EBITDA growth outpacing distributions; absent a moderation in buybacks, net leverage is more likely to drift sideways than fall.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率遠高於非必需消費品行業中位數，反映綜合度假村組合的定價能力，以及澳門與新加坡兩地嚴謹的成本控制。收入與營業收入均錄得同比增長，利潤率亦略有擴闊，支持盈利質量正在改善而非僅由銷量驅動的觀點。
經營現金流足以舒適地覆蓋資本開支與股息，單是自由現金流已覆蓋股息超過兩倍。此內部流動性生成為已承諾的建設項目提供資金而無需增量借貸，鑑於集團龐大的再投資需求，這是一項重大優勢。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿與淨槓桿均顯著高於行業中位數，而淨槓桿僅略低於下一個風險區間邊界，餘裕有限。EBITDA 溫和下降或債務增加將把狀況推入較弱層級，因此目前的「重要」指示性狀況對盈利波動敏感。
風險因素指出現金流基本上全部依賴兩個市場，母公司依賴附屬公司分派，同時面臨澳門與新加坡的特許經營權及牌照終止風險。非必需消費品的敏感性與旅遊中斷加劇了此集中度，使現金流的韌性低於多元化同業組合。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率同比改善並仍舒適地高於一，但約為行業中位數的一半，反映債務規模相對於營業收入的比重。覆蓋率屬足夠而非強勁，鑑於資本密集的度假村模式，與同業的差距屬結構性。
到期結構分佈良好，單一年度最大集中度落在第三年，五年之後亦有可觀的尾部。近期到期債務相對於現金結餘及年度自由現金流而言規模不大，因此再融資風險可控，惟該到期結構假設能持續以合理息差進入市場。

overall_credit_view.text: 股東分派吸納超過經營現金流，並大幅超過自由現金流，因此回購實際上由資產負債表能力而非內部產生現金支持。這是信用觀點的關鍵判斷：股東回報與去槓桿及建設項目直接競爭。
我們的前瞻觀點是，發行人保留類投資級的經營狀況，但槓桿高於行業中位數，且距下一區間的餘裕有限。去槓桿取決於 EBITDA 增長快於分派；若回購未見放緩，淨槓桿更可能橫向漂移而非下降。
